name: dojo-fx
description: Optional visuals for the dojo crew: themed spinners, turn-end flair, a live crew band, deploy/return toasts, and a model guard that keeps dojo agents on their own model.

spinners.title: Themed spinners
spinners.description: Replace the spinner word with the on-duty strategist's (or a crew member's) verbs.

turnFlair.title: Turn-end flair
turnFlair.description: Past-tense themed word on the line that closes a turn (Outmaneuvered, Checkmated).

band.title: Crew band
band.description: Show one animated row per running dojo subagent above the prompt.

toasts.title: Deploy/return toasts
toasts.description: Toast when a dojo subagent is deployed, returns or falls.

neutralMainTheme.title: Neutral strategist theme
neutralMainTheme.description: When no strategist persona is detected, still theme the main spinner with a neutral strategist pool.
